name: create-block/pagination-variation
title: Beegleton Pagination Variation (internal — not a real block)
description: Not a registered block. Exists only so the build pipeline compiles the editor-only script that registers the "Beegleton Pagination" variation of core/query-pagination, and the frontend script that adapts its colours to the background. Enqueued directly by my-custom-block.php (mcb_enqueue_pagination_variation).
